templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a services agreement governing the provider's AI features, covering customer Input and Output, use of data for model training, and related restrictions.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose, and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying SaaS/cloud software, covering access and use, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability limits, and termination.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement giving an early design partner access to a pre-release product in exchange for feedback, with terms on IP, confidentiality, and term.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: GDPR-style data processing terms defining controller/processor roles, subprocessors, security measures, data subject requests, breach notification, and international transfers.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA under which both parties may share confidential information for a stated purpose, with use and disclosure restrictions.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA capturing the variable deal terms (purpose, effective date, MNDA term, confidentiality term, governing law, jurisdiction) and signatures.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for business partnerships between two companies, covering each party's obligations, fees and payments, trademark licensing, confidentiality, indemnification, and liability.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product, giving the customer access for evaluation purposes with appropriate warranty and liability limits.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for professional services delivered under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, IP ownership, warranties, and liability.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level terms for a cloud service defining target uptime, support response times, and service credits when commitments are missed.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise or installed software, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, and liability.
